title: What's new in v3.0
items: Added a redesigned PornPics home with Now popular, Recommended for you, New on PornPics, Continue browsing and Popular tags sections.
Added full in-plugin directories for tags, performers and studios with search, Popular and A–Z sorting, and pagination.
Search results are now more visual and progressively load preview images for tags, performers and studios.
Recommendations are generated locally from galleries you browse; no external tracking is added.
footer: This update is a bit experimental. If you encounter any issues, message @bprpi on the forum
